nodes.label: Crate as a Reviewed Pool
nodes.rationale: A crate intentionally remains broader than a final ordered set so candidates can be revisited and auditioned later.

nodes.label: Separate Score Surfaces
nodes.rationale: CLAP text scores, seed-search similarities, and Audio Dedup thresholds answer different questions and should not be compared directly.

nodes.label: Listening-Led Shortlisting
nodes.rationale: The app narrows a large collection into candidates, while explicit listening determines what survives.

nodes.label: Preview-First Working Habit
nodes.rationale: Users should work in previews and export or apply only after listening or reviewing reports.
